purpose: What the release archive carries so a rebuild needs as little from the network as the licenses allow. Everything listed here is redistributable; MSVC and the Windows SDK are deliberately absent because Microsoft forbids redistributing them.
alias_note: LLVM ships one driver binary under several names and picks its behaviour from argv[0]. Storing it once and recreating the other names on install saves about 400 MB: clang/clang++/clang-cl/clang-cpp are the same 103 MB file, as are lld/lld-link/ld.lld and llvm-ar/llvm-lib/llvm-ranlib.

python.note: A relocatable CPython 3.12 (python.exe, its DLLs and standard library, plus PortableMSVC and its dependencies in Lib/site-packages), assembled by tools/toolchain-provision/New-BundledPython.ps1. Deliberately not a virtual environment: a venv names its base interpreter by absolute path and stops with No Python at ... on every other machine. Used by the disc-image analysis, the coroutine map and PortableMSVC.

python-packages.note: The two extension modules scripts/analyze-title-image.py imports, staged where its --python-packages default already looks for them.

pwsh.license: MIT (PowerShell; bundled .NET runtime MIT, see ThirdPartyNotices.txt)
pwsh.note: PowerShell 7.6.5, the official PowerShell-7.6.5-win-x64.zip (SHA-256 32eb8f6cdce08f86e987d625a2733e54ac3e289ae7e1621b14c0b5bcec2434ea, as published in the release's hashes.sha256). Every rebuild step is a PowerShell 7 script; the launcher runs it straight from tools/toolchain-bundle/pwsh, so a machine without PowerShell 7 needs nothing installed.
